title: Live stream stalls indefinitely on mobile data
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in StreamBox, the user encountered: Live stream stalls indefinitely on mobile data.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Live now
2. Observe UI state: Buffering...
3. Observe UI state: Playback error

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Playback error.

## Environment
- App: StreamBox
- Platform: android
